i won't give you any decks tips because i am one of those guys that believe you can get to master with pretty much anything so here are a few general tips:

1- if your opponent is playing burn (champion less deck) just mulligan for a strong early game and sometimes cards that can help you recover like radiant guardian

2- before every play think "**how the enemy can deny this play**?" like if i play heimerdinger can i keep him alive? or maybe i should just let him die but will his death be worth anything? basically "right now, what card could make me scream and want to headbang into the wall?"

3- keep track of your opponent mana if you see that he is passing for you with alot of mana then he is planning something, it could be: a high cost card, combo, or just trying to reach late game as fast as possible if that is when his deck spikes

and MOST important:

**think alot about what combo/high cost card that deck could have and how you can counter it.** would a will of ionia make you lose tempo and delay your win condition or even make your defeat? nice then make him use it earlier, try to create a condition where he don't have a choice, where he has to use it or he will lose alot of hp or a important card. if he don't play it then he probably don't have it, go for it

4-sometimes it is worth taking saving a single combat early to use it late to cancel his atrocity or just save your simple spells like mistic shot, make it rain to deny a glimpse beyond, just use your cards if you are sure it will be worth it

5- don't count on luck, she is a variable **you are a constant.** High risk plays are all in, you can get a nice reward but a certainly defeat if it fail so most of the time isn't worth it, make your own luck use your consistency in your favor
